meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.

examples.text: アダルトの女優が大企業の広告なんて、時代も変わったよね。
examples.trans: An adult video actress in a major corporate ad—times really have changed.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Attached to surnames, given names, or company names to show everyday respect; never used for oneself.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Noun.

examples.text: 時代が変わりましたね。

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
Godan verb; コミュニケーションを取る means 'to communicate'.

examples.text: よく連絡を取っています。
メモを取ってもいいですか。

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Adverbial noun used for strong certainty.

examples.text: 明日は絶対に来てください。
二十四時間アダルトビデオが見れる時代は、すぐそこまで来てますからね。
examples.trans: Because the era when people can watch adult videos twenty-four hours a day is right around the corner.

examples.text: 絶対に二十四時間エロを見られる時代は来るんですよ。
examples.trans: The era when people can watch erotica twenty-four hours a day will definitely come.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb: blunt imperative 見ろ ('look!') is rough command speech.
Irregular verb: くる -> きます -> きました.
Signals recognizing someone ('Oh, Toshi!') or letting out a feeling ('Man, I'm hungry').
Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.
Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Godan verb; in 役に立つ, means 'to be useful'.

examples.text: ここに立ってください。
この経験はきっと役に立ちます。
examples.trans: This experience will surely be useful.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.en: whichever (after question word); or something like
meanings.note: After どれ (どれでも) means 'any one at all'; after a noun (店でも) suggests an example ('a shop or something').

examples.text: いつでも来てください。
お茶でも飲みませんか。
examples.trans: Won't you have tea or something?

examples.text: でもみんな村西さんを超えてかなきゃダメなんですって！
examples.trans: Still, everyone needs to surpass Mr. Muranishi!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Everyday spoken counterpart of なぜ or どうして.

examples.text: なんで知っているんですか。

meanings.note: Expresses sudden surprise, shock, or disbelief.

examples.text: えっ、もう帰るんですか。
examples.trans: Huh, are you going home already?

meanings.note: Core everyday reassurance or check covering safety, health, and reliability.

examples.text: 心配しないで、大丈夫だよ。
examples.trans: Do not worry, it is fine.

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.

examples.text: いっぱい作るのはいいんだけど、強い一発を見てえんだよ。
examples.trans: Making tons of tapes is fine, yet I want to see one powerhouse hit.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

examples.text: 大丈夫だよ。一発で黙らしてやったよ。
examples.trans: I'm fine. I shut him right up with one shot.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: do for an inferior (tough-guy てやる)
meanings.note: After て-form (勘弁してやる), expresses granting a favor from a position of authority.

examples.trans: I will give you a hand (casual masculine).

examples.text: 最悪の事態だ。もうどうなっても知りませんよ。
examples.trans: This is the worst possible outcome. Don't blame me for whatever happens now.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: 最悪の事態だ。もうどうなっても知りませんよ。
examples.trans: This is the worst possible outcome. Don't blame me for whatever happens now.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: In もういい, means 'already enough' or 'ready now'.
Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).
Expresses change of state, or in polite customer service (になります) states an arrangement or price total.

examples.trans: That comes to one thousand yen.

meanings.en: know; find out; be aware of
meanings.note: Godan verb; state of knowing is 知っている.

examples.text: 彼の電話番号を知っていますか。
examples.trans: Do you know his phone number?

examples.text: 本当の理由を知りたい。
examples.trans: I want to know the real reason.

meanings.note: Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.
Godan intransitive verb; 黙ってろ! is a rough 'Shut up!'.

meanings.en: that (near the listener or just mentioned)
meanings.note: Must always precede a noun (その椅子 'that chair').
Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。

meanings.note: Used both to answer yes politely and when handing an item to someone.
Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。
